# Video V-01: Settle the morning's exceptions list

## Script

Say: "This is how the order coordinator does this, at the start of each day, before new orders arrive." [SC-10]

1. Show and say: "Open the exceptions list at the start of the day." [SC-10 step 1]
2. Show and say: "Settle each line: correct the code or note it for the customer." [SC-10 step 2]

| shot | on screen | source |
